22-//
23-// The migration system handles database schema versioning and upgrades.
24-// Schema version is stored in system_setting.
25-//
26-// Migration Flow:
27:// 1. preMigrate: Check if DB is initialized. If not, apply LATEST.sql
28-// 2. checkMinimumUpgradeVersion: Verify installation can be upgraded (reject pre-0.22 installations)
29-// 3. Migrate (prod mode): Apply incremental migrations from current to target version
30-// 4. Migrate (demo mode): Seed database with demo data
31-// Deployment configuration is loaded separately after migration completes.
32-//

37-//
38-// Migration Files:
39-// - Location: store/migration/{driver}/{version}/NN__description.sql
40-// - Naming: NN is zero-padded patch number, description is human-readable
41-// - Ordering: Files sorted lexicographically and applied in order
42:// - LATEST.sql: Full schema for new installations (faster than incremental migrations)
